description: Findeln is a hamlet of dark Walser houses and barns on a south-facing shelf above Zermatt, with golden larch and short alpine grass around the wood. The Matterhorn shows only as a distant peak beyond the roofs, so this is not the Gornergrat portrait, the Bahnhofstrasse, or the Klein Matterhorn. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and cool, with a breeze and no precipitation, and the late sun comes from the west.
